name: Madron
text: Madron is a variant spelling of Modron. Modron is the Welsh divine mother. Her son Mabon appears in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen. Readers who look for Madron should turn to the entry on Modron.

okr.objective: Documents Madron as a variant spelling of the Welsh goddess Modron.
